answer: A farm of 291 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are written down in relic, queued in canyon, and hollow publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 98 identities per epoch. A farm of 1189 identities would post 2579 proofs and burn roughly 9 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
